research_scope: Four unique base-game skills from PQ81-PQ85 after removing Charge, which was already canonically researched in batch 19.

records.name: Afterimage Strike
records.character_source: Goku (GT); Goku (Super Saiyan 4); Beerus; Gogeta (Super Saiyan 4); Vegito
records.skill_description: Creates a flurry of afterimages around the opponent, allowing the user to move and immediately follow with another technique.
records.mechanics_notes: Current skill-specific data classifies Afterimage Strike as an Other Super using 100 Ki. The move creates repeated afterimages and can be followed by another attack.

records.name: Dragon Burn
records.skill_description: A close-range Janemba technique that traps the opponent in a sustained attack sequence.
records.mechanics_notes: The PQ reward is independently confirmed for PQ82, but the accessible current sources used in this batch did not establish a sufficiently reliable resource cost or full technical specification, so those fields remain unresolved.

records.name: Saiyan Spirit
records.skill_description: Rushes in with a Saiyan-powered punch and follows with a blue Ki Wave.
records.mechanics_notes: Current skill-specific data classifies Saiyan Spirit as a Ki Blast Ultimate using 300 Ki and restricts CaC use to Saiyans. The attack deals its damage across the rush and follow-up Ki Wave.

records.name: Zigzag Express
records.skill_description: Charges through the opponent with air warped around the user's body and allows slight directional control.
records.mechanics_notes: Current skill-specific data classifies Zigzag Express as a Strike Super using 100 Ki and restricts CaC use to Male Majins. The move is a short-range controllable four-hit rush.
